prompt.objetivo: Close the request with verifiable evidence. The report is part of the work, not an appendix.

hacer.paso: List files created or modified and the reason.
Separate checks that were executed, checks that were not executed, and assumptions.
Update docs/vexarq/status.html. The current phase, its state, and the link to the current artifact.
If the change is versioned, propose the commit from the delivery format. Create it only when the user asked for it.

push.regla: Do not push, force-push, or publish without an explicit request that names the remote and the branch.
Before an authorized push, run the applicable checks. If one fails, there is no push.
